records.meaning: A browser, Swing desktop or other renderer surface bound to one authoritative Wire UI application/session context.
Logical client communications object that owns ordered direct-queue delivery, subscription reconciliation, correlation and reconnect/transport framing.
Authorised wiring state selecting definitions, observation points and journey capability preparation; not the live event transport.
Queue delivery of actual semantic communications/events such as UI_ACTION, snapshot, patch, chat or interaction observation.
Immutable exact version-qualified semantic element definition prepared once by a renderer.
Cold-cache runtime barrier that holds ordered patches referencing an authorised missing immutable definition until that exact definition is installed.
Server-selected renderer capability/display class such as compact-touch or large-fine.
Server-authoritative semantic projection such as HUMAN_VISUAL or AI_AGENT_OPTIMISED.
Gateway-assigned contiguous ordering for one access point; distinct from manager-wide QueueWorkPackage sequence.
Exact immutable identity/provenance for an externally authored resource: resourceId, version, contentAddress, resourceClass and optional locale.
External authority that owns resource bytes, provenance, version lifecycle, accessibility, approval/publication and representation catalogue.
Runtime boundary that verifies exact resource manifest/bytes and chooses one pre-approved representation for a renderer/delivery profile.
Local focus, cursor, partial typing, scroll/layout/animation state that need not round-trip until it becomes a semantic action.
Server-recognised operation such as FLIGHT.SEARCH or SERVICE.CANCEL.BEGIN carrying exact rendered-revision context, not a DOM selector/click coordinate.
Production-like static delivery of one content-addressed gzip JS runtime with immutable caching while live application state stays authoritative and fresh.
